measurement: World XY finite difference projected into midpoint yaw heading; yaw unwrapped from body pose oracle; rolling 0.5s mean, shorter at startup. Diagnostic truth is not vision control.
limitations: This combined 35-second demonstration is not the predeclared independent 20-second qualification protocol.
Prior low-speed forward0.2 and lateral0.1 trials undertracked; representative0.5 and yaw0.3 demonstration does not remove those failures.
No official soccer kick or B-Human football policy is used.
